sentences.text:
Bench: Tirthankar Ghosh
M/L 737
07.08.2025
ct.no.35
Kausik
 W.P.A. 16606 of 2024

With  CAN 1 of 2024  Mrs. Rima Adhikary & Ors.
 Versus  The Officer-in-Charge (IC), Dakineswar Police  Station & Ors.
 Mr. Rajarshi Basu  Mr. K.M. Hossain  ...for the State.
Petitioner has approached this Court calling  for an interference in connection with Dakhineswar  Police Station 72/24.
I find from the records that the  said case was registered on 23.05.2024 under section 498A of the Indian Penal Code.

More than 14  months have passed since such case was registered,
 there is change of circumstances with passage of  time.

It is also reflected from the report submitted by  the police authorities that there was a matrimonial  dispute, consequent to which MAT 1182 of 2024 was  filed before the learned District Judge, Alipore.

The  criminal case under section 498A was also registered Mrs. Rima Adhikary & Ors vs The Officer-In-Charge (Ic) on 7 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/197631940/

sentences.text: Having considered that substantial time has passed and the prayer so advanced were interim in nature, I am of the view that no interference is called for at this belated stage.
Petitioner will take steps before the jurisdictional Court in seisin of Dakhineswar PS Case No. 72/24.
With the aforesaid observations WPA 16606 of 2024 is disposed of.
Pending application, if any, be consequently disposed of.
Report submitted be kept with the record.
All parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.
